text: No deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The analysis shows that by 2020, the asset had no remaining forest cover (0% share, per JRC GFC2020). While small tree-cover loss patches (0.4 ha) were detected in 2021, these were below the 0.5 ha minimum event threshold and thus not counted as deforestation. All prior deforestation events (2008, 2015, 2017, 2020) occurred before the 2020 baseline. The asset was already deforested by the claim start date.
